prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access to pull current local ratings, so I can’t name a single “best” salon in Tyler right now. I can, however, help you find the best one for your needs and tell you what to look for. Quick question first: are you looking for UV tanning (beds/booths) or a spray/sunless tan?

If you want to decide on your own, here’s a short checklist and how to search:

How to search
- Google Maps or Yelp: search “tanning salon near Tyler, TX” and sort by rating + recent reviews.
- Check each salon’s website or Instagram for photos of the facility and staff.
- Read the most recent reviews — look for comments about cleanliness, equipment condition, and customer service.

What makes a salon “best”
- Cleanliness and hygiene (clean beds, fresh linens, sanitized spray rooms)
- Well-maintained, modern equipment (newer beds or low-pressure/high-pressure options depending on what you want)
- Trained, professional staff who do a skin assessment and explain exposure times
- Variety of services (spray tan, red-light/LED, tanning beds/booths) if you want options
- Transparent pricing and membership options
- Good safety practices (eye protection, clear instructions, patch tests for spray tans)
- Consistently positive recent reviews (not just old 5-star ratings)

Questions to ask or look for in reviews
- How old are the tanning beds and are they well-maintained?
- Do they offer a skin consultation and customized time recommendations?
- How is the spray-tan finish (natural-looking, even, lasting 7–10 days)?
- Do they offer patch tests for spray tans or hypoallergenic solutions?
- Are staff friendly and professional?
- Are there any recurring complaints about cleanliness or smell?

Safety note
- Limit UV exposure and follow recommended exposure times. Consider getting a spray tan if you’re trying to avoid UV risks.
- If you have fair skin, a history of skin cancer, or many moles, check with a dermatologist before tanning.

If you want, paste the top 3–5 salon names or links you find and I’ll help you compare them and pick the best one.
